points.description: States that the compiler copies the body (code) of the inline function, rather than generating a single shared copy that is called. Equivalent wording such as 'the function's code is inserted/expanded in place' earns the mark.

States that the copy is placed at every place where the function is called (each call site), so the call is replaced by the copied code. Equivalent wording such as 'substituted wherever the function is invoked' earns the mark.
